harnessMechanism: A preserved781.4ms gap between recording readback and pointerdown allowed completion before the test press. Pointerdown intent alone cannot repair that test.

sharedCompletionRoute: Both endpoint callbacks -> resolveAdvance -> pendingStopAfterRender -> copyFrameAfterRender -> stopRecording -> recorder.onstop -> finalizeExport -> idle; only the endpoint policy differs.
